title: Monotonic Stack: Pattern recognition and reusable templates

scenes.title: Mental model
bullets: Keep unresolved candidates in monotonic order; a new value resolves every dominated candidate once.

scenes.title: State contract
bullets: Stack indices remain monotonic by value and each stored index is still waiting for its resolving boundary.

scenes.title: Implementation sequence
bullets: flush with a sentinel when necessary

scenes.title: Worked reasoning
bullets: For next greater element, pop smaller values when a larger value arrives and assign the current index as their answer.

scenes.title: Complexity proof
bullets: O(n) time because each index is pushed and popped at most once; O(n) space.
